sloka: त्वां तु दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनं परिष्वज्य सलक्ष्मणम् ।अद्य दुःखाद्विमुक्तो ऽस्मि नीहारादिव भास्करः ।। ६.१२२.१६ ।।
transliteration: tvāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā kuśalinaṁ pariṣvajya salakṣmaṇam ।adya duḥkhādvimukto 'smi nīhārādiva bhāskaraḥ ।। 6.122.16 ।।

translations.english: "Seeing you with Lakshmana and embracing you makes me happy freed from grief just as the sun freed from mist."
